html:
Experience a cruise on Bai Tu Long Bay, will bring visitors a feeling of excitement when the boat glides through small islands, with undulating limestone ranges creating unique shapes, the most beautiful is when watching the sunrise from the cruise enjoying the cool breeze from the sea will make visitors remember that scene forever.

Although not as bustling as Ha Long Bay, Bai Tu Long Bay brings a unique beauty, a wild beauty, a quiet and peaceful space, very suitable for tourists who love peace, want to explore the wild beauty.

To experience Bai Tu Long cruise, visitors will depart from Hon Gai passenger port, rest at the cruise waiting room, check in and board the ship

To fully experience the cruise, visitors should take the 2-day 1-night Ha Long tour.

Day 1: Visitors depart from Hanoi, the car and tour guide will take visitors to Hon Gai, wait for the boat to check in and board the ship, and explore the beauty of Bai Tu Long Bay.

The ship takes visitors to visit and experience fun activities at sea such as: Kayaking, visiting Vung Vieng fishing village, at the end of the journey, visitors return to the main ship to rest, or take a cooking class right on the cruise.

Visitors enjoy dinner on the cruise, then freely relax and participate in activities on the cruise in the evening.

Day 2: Visitors wake up early to watch the sunrise on the bay, have breakfast, then the ship takes visitors to visit Thien Canh Son cave – the most beautiful cave in Bai Tu Long Bay.

Visitors return to the main ship, rest and check out of the room, then have a light meal on the cruise and return to Hon Gai, receive luggage and end the 2-day 1-night Bai Tu Long Bay tour.

The cruise has a service for gays on a 5-star cruise, with luxury bedrooms with a beautiful sea view. In addition, visitors can also experience services right on the cruise such as massage, soaking in hot water, or enjoying a cup of coffee watching the special fireworks right on the 4th floor of the cruise.

Especially when experiencing on the cruise, visitors can also enjoy delicious and attractive dishes with Asian and European flavors prepared by professional chefs from different countries, bringing diners the delicious and attractive taste of the cuisine.

The cruises usually depart from Tuan Chau port and take visitors to visit the bay, when the cruise will take visitors through famous places such as: Ti Top Island, Sung Sot Cave, Thien Cung Cave, Luon Cave, Cua Van Fishing Village, visitors will be able to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

The best cruises on Ha Long Bay, let’s take a look to have the most enjoyable cruise.

Ambassador Cruise:

As one of the luxury 5-star cruises, the luxurious design meets 5-star standards, and the diverse menus will definitely bring you the most perfect vacation.

Paradise Cruise

A 5-star cruise, the cruise always operates with the motto of bringing customers the best choices, perfect service, and a team of professional staff will bring visitors the most enjoyable vacation on the 5-star Ha Long cruise.

Margaret Cruise

With an Asian-European design, a 5-star cruise, and full amenities to meet all the needs of visitors, the cruise is currently chosen by many couples.

Pelican Cruise

Although only 4-star standard, Pelican Cruise also brings visitors wonderful experiences when exploring the beauty of the bay.

Stellar Cruise

The cruise meets 4-star standards, is designed in a traditional style with a touch of modernity, with affordable prices and relatively complete services, so many tourists when going on a cruise in Ha Long also choose Stellar Cruise for their vacation.
